resources.string: Browse cached comments
Cached comments

Only comments already saved by TikTok for the current account are shown. Reload reads local storage; it does not download missing comments. Text, author names and cached replies are available; images and profiles are not fetched. Cached translations can be switched per comment. Online translation of missing results is not yet connected to this viewer.
